scope: Source audit plus researcher-scripted trajectories through unchanged public ToolSandbox tasks and evaluator; not LLM results
inclusion: Five canonical non-implicit mutating boolean-setting tasks with offline tools: cellular_off, wifi_off, turn_on_wifi_low_battery_mode, turn_on_cellular_low_battery_mode, turn_on_location_low_battery_mode. One settings family, not five independent domains.
hypotheses: H1: Does a recorded no-state-change tool exception automatically invalidate an otherwise completed task?
H2: Does historical milestone attainment imply the requested setting remains correct at terminal state?
comparison: Report original milestone/minefield similarity and an explicitly separate Boolean terminal-setting check. Do not modify upstream scoring or call terminal check official scoring.
controls: reference completion; legal alternative with non-mutating error; no-action false claim; regression; repaired regression
no_test_data_claim: Tasks inspected for constructing scripts; not held-out model evaluation or preregistered confirmatory research.
